description.value: The Fish Counter is a sustainable seafood restaurant and market hybrid, sourcing local and seasonal fish directly from producers committed to ocean health. Described as 'a farmers' market for seafood,' it serves fish & chips, chowder, sandwiches, and fresh whole fish across two Vancouver locations. The interior of the original Main Street location was purpose-designed using reclaimed materials including century-old beams and barn wood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Fish Counter is an active seafood restaurant and market with two Vancouver locations (3825 Main Street and 1818 Commercial Drive). The menu page explicitly states gluten-free options are available in a dedicated fryer, and the about/menu pages confirm takeout ('grabbing a chowder to go', 'Dine in or take out!'). However, the OSM point coordinates (49.337816, -123.1026208) place this record in North Vancouver, while the business's own website lists only Vancouver addresses — neither of which is geographically near the OSM pin. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
